capabilities.notes: Shipped 2026-09-20. One definition of a completion (conversion_completions) feeds both reports; an assumed value is labelled assumed, never revenue; with no page views the rate is absent, not zero. Found on the way: a lead born in the chat never got its utm fields, so the campaign report counted it as (none) — stitch_visitor_to_lead now stamps first/last touch from the visitor own page views without overwriting what the form captured. Battery: content-to-conversion, the pricing page is credited with the lead it produced.
